_comment_chat: Below is for the !song chat bot. Easiest way: press 'Set up the bot' on the dashboard's Chat bot tab and this half fills itself in, including botRefreshToken so the sign-in renews on its own. By hand instead: a token with chat:read and chat:edit for the account the bot speaks as, keeping the oauth: prefix, and leave botRefreshToken blank.
_comment_api: Below is for the follower/sub alerts and boxes, read by NowPlayingOverlay.exe. This is a SEPARATE token from the chat one above. Only moderator:read:followers is required; add channel:read:subscriptions as well if you also want subscriber alerts. The clientId MUST be the client the token was issued to, or Twitch rejects every request. clientSecret and refreshToken are OPTIONAL - add both and the app renews apiToken on its own before it expires, rewriting this file automatically, instead of you regenerating it by hand every few hours. Leave them blank if you would rather regenerate the token by hand when it expires.
